relevance_note: A 'How I Treat' clinical review of HA20 ('this review aims to highlight key principles in our approach to patients with known or suspected HA20') that gives only group-level frequencies (Table 1, Table S1) and no individual-level patient detail.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown, including the converted Supplementary Table 1, by hand; no table was transcribed by script. Table 1 and Table S1 give only percentages or counts for published reviews and the authors' multicenter cohort (ref 22, 185 cases), so no individuals are extracted and no checklist rows are emitted. One person is mentioned in passing in the Treatment section ('In one severe and refractory case, we have referred a patient for allogeneic stem cell transplantation, who has been in drug-free remission for over 2 years after transplant'); the paper gives no sex, age, variant or clinical feature for this person and does not state the HA20 diagnosis for them explicitly, so by analogy with the v4 passing-mention rule they were left out of scope. n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated left null: the paper describes no patients of its own, and the counts it prints (~200 reported cases worldwide; 199, 177, 54, 12 and 185 in Table 1) belong to cited publications. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null for the same reason (the 185-case cohort is 'from our group' (22), but its patients are only summarized at group level). No contradictions found.
